items.title: The universal module of differentials of sheaves of rings is the sheafification of the presheaf of modules of differentials of the rings of sections
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the universal module of differentials of a homomorphism of sheaves of rings with the sheaf associated to the presheaf assigning to an open the module of differentials of the corresponding rings of sections (author lemma at source lines 5052-5058, label lemma-differentials-sheafify). The proof (source lines 5060-5076) writes down the presheaf analogue of the defining map, identifies its cokernel on an open with the algebraic module of differentials, and concludes because the sheaves appearing in the defining map are the sheafifications of those presheaves and sheafification is exact (proof lines 5061-5075). The comparison of the two constructions is the content; the defining map is reproduced as a context span. H2.

contexts.label: the displayed map defining the universal module of differentials, reproduced verbatim as context from the construction of that module (source lines 4999-5011), because the counted proof refers twice to that equation and compares it with its presheaf analogue
